# Fused PWM pass-through harness for the pressure fan

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `fan-power-harness` |
| Category | fabricated |
| Role | feeds the San Ace motor from the PSU and passes PWM/tach to the QUADRO |
| Status | design |
| Quantity | 1 |
| Systems | berserk |

PSU 4-pin peripheral (Molex) 12 V and ground -> 5 A inline blade fuse -> fan
pins 2 (+12 V, red) and 1 (ground, black). Fan pin 3 (tach, yellow) and pin 4
(PWM, brown) -> QUADRO channel pins 3 and 4. QUADRO channel pin 1 (ground)
joins the fan ground for a common reference; QUADRO pin 2 (+12 V) stays
unconnected. Use 18 AWG for the 12 V pair. Confirm the San Ace starting
current (catalog p.616) is within the fuse's slow-blow curve.

## Model

- Source: constructed
- Assembly: **not in the assembly**: flexible wiring; route along the hood clear of the fan rotor
